message: 車体色はブラック

name: Lolotte
message: 「Looking around, pacing back and forth」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte? You seem restless, what's wrong? Did you drop something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, you came at just the right time. I'm looking for 'pebbles,' you see, and there are only little stones lying around here...」

name: Synn
message: 「'Pebbles' are little stones, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What!? Now that I know that... yoink, yoink, yoink, yoink!」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you going to do gathering up things like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going to hurl them at Kaoru. Burn, burn, buuurn~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, you can't! You mustn't do something like that to your friend!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's nothing like a friend」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Obviously, I'm talking about the artificial intelligence installed in Jiiya's car, the Dream Supercar Tamiko 3.0 'Kaoru'」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that obvious?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course it is? It's a matching pair with the Helena 2000 'Kitou' that the Chairwoman rides in」
I-I don't really get it...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Angels love all living things. In other words, it's totally fine to beat up inanimate objects♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!! I-I'm n-n-n-not an angel」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's cornered bad enough to play both straight man and funny man all by herself」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, calm down first. What happened?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, please listen. It's a long story, but--」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's a long story, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lately, Kaoru has been bullying me. It must be jealous of how close Jiiya and I are, without a doubt」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, that was short」

name: Lolotte
message: 「While I'm being chauffeured around, it's constantly nagging me to prepare and review my lessons, not forget my homework, brush my teeth, take a bath, and on and on!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's not being mean at all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, I want to shut it up good. Seethe, seethe, seeeethe~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, if it's just prepping or reviewing, even I can help you out, you know? Which part of the textbook did Kaoru point out?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okay! Let's show Kaoru what we're made of.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's see, in math--」
For the few brief minutes until Riesling's car arrives, I tutor Lolotte.
Suddenly, a thought crosses my mind. Isn't this playing right into "Kaoru's" hands?
